mechanisms: plain copies of new (args=&(new,), Some(new), &Some(new), mut su) are dropped: new is a noalias readonly arg, the copy is forwarded and the sharing arm reads the arg
the original 7/8/8/9 split of the copy appears only when validate reads the copy (y4/t4/d1); b1 (y4 + plain PDA) reproduces the original entry sequence and puts the pieces at 0x658/0x668
plain let (holder_key,_)=PDA gives the original PDA sequence (seeds -0x450, sret -0x2d0) and helps every entry-copy form by +0.01..0.03, but loses on k1 where hk stands in for the 40 B
raw-IR clobber of %new after validate keeps the copy at entry but unsplit (32 B piece at 0x678): 0.511
unresolved: original validate reads new's 7/9 ends from the arg and its [8]/[16] from the entry copy SSA (GVN), so the copy must survive without validate reading it
target.sroa.0 (7 B piece of the 7/8/8/9 target) occupies 0x650/0x658; the original target is 8/24 split
